resolved_findings.finding: Relations API failure was silently replaced with feed-derived or empty data.
resolved_findings.resolution: Render localized truthful error and Retry without approximate fallback.

resolved_findings.finding: Overlapping tab loads could let a slow response replace the latest selection.
resolved_findings.resolution: Generation gate plus connected/exact-host checks discard stale responses.

resolved_findings.finding: Dynamic identities could visually reorder beside Arabic text.
resolved_findings.resolution: Display names use auto BDI and Nexus handles use an isolated LTR run.

resolved_findings.finding: Delayed request mutations could force navigation back to Requests.
resolved_findings.resolution: Completion refreshes only if the originating Requests view remains current and connected.

resolved_findings.finding: Raw backend action errors could override localized feedback.
resolved_findings.resolution: Stable catalogue messages are primary; raw detail is excluded from the user-facing toast.

resolved_findings.finding: Concurrent request mutations could refresh before a slower commit.
resolved_findings.resolution: All request actions share a synchronous single-flight gate and one authoritative refresh.
